dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Well, take this chunk of rock, for example. Looks perfectly ordinary, but in fact it came from a star.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: A very long time ago, a star fell from the sky. The force of the impact when it hit the ground is what turned it this color on the outside.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hmm? What do you mean, looks like a regular chunk of ore?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: ...Wait, no, you're right, sorry. I grabbed the wrong one. This is just a regular chunk of ore.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Ugh, must be the suppliers. They're always trying to sneak the odd dud into the mix... so frustrating...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Please, take it off my hands would you? I never want to see it again.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hello! Can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I am Linlang, the owner of Xigu Antiques.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, but the shop is not open yet. If you want to browse the shop, please find me at Xigu Antiques later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Xigu Antiques.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: A fellow antique collector, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: In that case, I do hope you will come to the store tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Right now, though, I am taking my post-breakfast walk. Apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Bye. It was a pleasure meeting you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just taking a stroll nearby to relax. I'd like to admire the scenery one more time before the sun sets.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This land has remained at peace for a thousand years now. But sometimes, I wonder — how did the people who walked this land a thousand years ago feel?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I cannot know, yes, but our Lord certainly does — Rex Lapis, who has gently watched over this land for a millennium...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: ...I wonder, has there been anyone at all who has been privy to his feelings across this long period?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Welcome to my humble shop! We have some new items in store, if you would be so kind as to take a look at them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hello, I am Linlang, the owner of this store.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Do you see anything you like?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Please take as long as you need; there is plenty to see and no rush to choose.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you would recommend?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Take a look at this piece of flint. It is a shard from the tip of the Geo Lord's polearm. Notice the ancient symbols written on there, with the masterful brushwork following the lines that naturally appear on the material's surface.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Or this fossilized wood. It is a runner from a primordial tree, and legend says that this tree was so gigantic its root system spread throughout the entire world.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: You might also consider this bottle, which contains the venomous blood of an evil dragon that once wrought havoc on a neighboring land. Due to exposure to the air, the blood has now dried and turned to dust...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: ...However, the venom is so strong that one pinch of it would suffice to take out all the strongest men in a village. Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Beyond these, there are many other rarities and oddities in store, too. Feel free to peruse them at your leisure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds dubious to me...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Well, the value of an antique is whatever you make of it.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There is a saying: "An antique's credibility is born of its owner's credulity." It is one's belief in an item as a historical relic that imbues it with meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: By contrast, when you believe that an antique is fake, your denial of the item's value does not change the item in any way.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: The fact is, the items themselves hold no value for my customers. It is the stories attached to the items that hold the real value.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There's another saying, how does it go... "As long as you have a good story to tell, you'll always find a way forward..." The same principle applies to antiques.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Come back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy some antiques.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Yes, please browse as you like. You'll find that our antiques here are worth every Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Impressive, wasn't it? Even in death, the gods pass in glory, unlike the surreptitious departure of mortals... I'm glad I was able to witness an event of such magnificence.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: It's just a shame that I couldn't have met him, or talked to him about my dreams...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Ah, what I am saying? Sorry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Linlang. I run an antiques shop called Xigu Antiques... I don't know if we've met?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There's an abiding sense of nostalgia in the air at Lantern Rite... Normally I only get that feeling in my shop; I love it, it makes me feel so at home.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite is much more ancient than any of the antiques in my shop, though.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Antiquity has real value. I should know, I make my living off that fact. So make the most of this very precious time of year.
